Typed Workout: saved order matches review, staged progress, paste & delight

Journal order fix:
- Imported sets shared one performedAt and the journal sorts only by it,
  so tied rows came back scrambled. The importer now spaces the sets by a
  millisecond ordinal cascade: the first reviewed set is the newest, so the
  newest-first journal reproduces the exact review order. The cascade steps
  forward from the effective date (a date-only midnight pick never spills
  into the previous day), stays sub-second, and explicit per-set times still
  win. Benefits the scan flow too.

Preview generation progress:
- WorkoutScanParsing gains a staged parse variant (default implementation
  forwards to the plain parse) reporting WorkoutParseStage: notation pass,
  each Apple Intelligence pass, finalizing. The processing step is now a
  determinate bar with stage label and percent; a timer eases toward the
  current stage anchor so the bar keeps moving during long model passes
  without fabricating completion.

UX accelerators + delight:
- System PasteButton in the input step (no paste-permission prompt, no
  programmatic clipboard reads; offered only when the clipboard has text).
- Exercise reorder controls in review (per-section list can't use .onMove);
  since draft order is import order, this also fixes saved order.
- The imported screen shows total volume (sum of weight x reps in the
  user's preferred unit) and celebrates beaten PRs via the existing tested

- Rep ladders/pyramids: "225x5/3/1", "5/3/1 @ 225", "3x10-8-6" parse to one

- Tempo notation ("3x5 tempo 31x1", "(31X1)") is stripped as noise, fixing

- Round/circuit headers ("3 rounds:", "Circuit 1", "three rounds:") are

Free-form notation parsing: real pole-vault note now parses exactly (eval 25/25)

A real user note failed badly in build 52 ("4 x 20-meter accelerations at
85-90%" imported as 20 reps). Fixes across all three layers:

Deterministic parser:
- Dash normalization: en/em dashes -> "-"; digit-letter hyphens attach units
  ("20-meter" -> "20meter") while digit-digit ("8-10") and word-word
  ("Rear-delt") hyphens survive.
- Word weight units (pound/pounds/kilogram/kilograms/kilo/kilos), longest-
  suffix-first.
- Intensity percentages ("85%", "85-90%") are noise, never a value.
- Rep ranges as B-values or bare specs use the lower bound.
- Distance B-values: "4x20m" -> 4 distance sets.
- Leading-spec fallback: name-after-numbers lines parse ("4x20m accelerations
  at 85-90%" -> "accelerations"), with filler-word exclusion.
- "N by M" == "NxM"; single/double/triple rep words; leading name fillers
  stripped ("worked up to ... on bench for a double" -> Bench 1x2 @ 225);
  lone bare numbers >= 25 are weights, not reps.

Arbiter:
- Colon durations tokenize as seconds ("1:30" -> 90) so correct rest parses
  are not scored as invented.
- New coverage component: drafts must explain the text's numbers (set counts,
  values, second-conversions, date components), so a plausible-but-incomplete
  parse can no longer beat the one that read the whole line.

FoundationModels passes:
- Instructions: distance-vs-reps rule ("N x 20-meter" is never reps),
  intensity/each-leg handling, hyphenated pound units, session-total vs
  per-set durations; rewrite pass gained a sprint/drill line format.
- Structured pass retries once, like the rewrite pass (refusals are
  intermittent).

Corpus grew to 25 cases (16 notation / 9 prose; five-by-five,
worked-up-to-a-double, goblet-squats re-tiered to notation). Live eval
25/25 (100%) two consecutive runs; 645 unit tests green.

On-device parsing quality overhaul: 50% -> 88% on eval corpus

The FoundationModels pipeline behind Typed Workout and Scan was measured at
50% exact-parse on a new 24-case corpus. Rebuilt around the house doctrine
(the model reads, code computes):

- Schema: GeneratedExercise now reports setCount + per-exercise values
  (Optionals, .anyOf units, .range counts, name declared first); code expands
  sets. The old schema needed N identical array elements for "3x8" and the
  ~3B model reliably emitted one. Dates: model extracts dateText, code
  resolves it (relative words + HandwrittenWorkoutParser.explicitDate).
- New WorkoutDraftArbiter (pure): deterministic parser always runs; model
  drafts win only when they score higher against the source text (NxM
  set-count agreement, unit-aware numeric fidelity incl. spelled numbers,
  distinct-name presence). Notation input keeps its exact deterministic
  parse (12/12 on corpus).
- Second model pass rewrites prose into gym notation lines that the
  deterministic parser parses - transliteration beats 12-field extraction
  on the small model.
- Guardrails: default guardrails refuse benign gym prose ("May contain
  sensitive content"); use SystemLanguageModel(guardrails:
  .permissiveContentTransformations), avoid copy/verbatim phrasing in
  instructions (anti-regurgitation refusal trigger), retry once (refusals
  are intermittent). Greedy sampling on all calls; prewarm on sheet appear.
- Eval harness: WorkoutParseEvalCorpus (24 cases), notation cases pinned
  against the deterministic parser in CI, prose cases pinned as
  deterministic failures, opt-in live-model eval asserting >=80% pass rate
  (currently 88%; run with TEST_RUNNER_MARBLE_FM_EVAL=1).

Fix 10 bugs from a full-codebase audit; add demo-fixture seed hook

Reliability pass on top of build 49, verified by 519 green unit tests
and a clean build-for-testing compile:

- NumberField: never display grouping separators in an editable field —
  the setter parses "," as a decimal point, so editing "1,500" silently
  collapsed it to 1.5 (any value >= 1,000, and any grouped value in
  comma-decimal locales).
- SetDetailView: guard the onDisappear write-back after Delete so it
  can't mutate a model whose backing data is gone; clear metrics the new
  exercise doesn't track (and the stale sprint snapshot) when an entry
  is reassigned, instead of leaving invisible values feeding Trends.
- Control Center "Log a Set": route through the marble://quicklog deep
  link — the plain AppIntent performs in the widget-extension process,
  where the NotificationCenter post was compiled out, so the control
  opened the app but never the logger.
- MarbleBackup restore: dedup body metrics on healthKitUUID as well as
  row id (a fresh device re-imports samples under new ids before a
  restore); never adopt a set entry into a second workout session —
  entries has no inverse, so membership silently double-counted.
- SeedData: stamp didSeed/didEnsureSplitPlan only after a durable save;
  one failed autosave used to leave a permanently empty library.
- ContentView: only fall back to the active session for today's quick
  log — Calendar's backdated "Log Set for this day" was appending past
  sets to the live session's count and sprint rep sequence.
- JournalView undo-delete: capture and restore the entry's imported-
  workout link and workout-session membership.
- WeeklyGoalReminder: suppress the nudge for users with zero lifetime
  sets (the synthesized .inProgress snapshot defeated plan()'s fresh-
  user guard).
- RestActivityController: serialize rest-alert schedule/cancel with the
  same generation-stamped chain as the ActivityKit path, so a cancel
  can't be overtaken by an in-flight add.
- AddSetView: stop clamping reps prefill to 20 — a 30-rep last set
  silently logged as 20; only the slider pins to its track.

Also: MARBLE_SEED_DEMO_FIXTURES seeds the screenshots fixture on a
normal launch for demo recordings, and the fixture's Workout-tab
session now matches whatever split the capture day seeds instead of
showing an empty, perpetually active "Leg Day" five days a week.
